name: docgen-mcp-server
description: Render HTML/markdown to PDF, export rows to xlsx, and fill AcroForm PDFs via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

DOCGEN_DOCUMENT_TTL_SECONDS.title: Document TTL (seconds)
DOCGEN_DOCUMENT_TTL_SECONDS.description: How long a rendered document is retrievable before it expires.

DOCGEN_MAX_DOCUMENT_BYTES.title: Max document size (bytes)
DOCGEN_MAX_DOCUMENT_BYTES.description: Hard ceiling on a single rendered artifact; exceeding it aborts the render.

DOCGEN_RENDER_TIMEOUT_MS.title: Render timeout (ms)
DOCGEN_RENDER_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Per-render wall-clock budget; exceeding it aborts the render.

DOCGEN_INLINE_MAX_BYTES.title: Inline size limit (bytes)
DOCGEN_INLINE_MAX_BYTES.description: Artifacts at or under this size are returned inline as base64; larger ones omit it.

DOCGEN_PDF_ENGINE.title: PDF engine
DOCGEN_PDF_ENGINE.description: PDF rendering engine. Only 'lightweight' is implemented in v1.
